candidates.title: 樱粉圣光
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-body design candidate for an original playable animated character in a Slay the Spire 2 mod. This image is a design preview used to choose a character before creating separate layered parts and animation.
Reference image: attached photograph supplies facial likeness and hairstyle cues only. Keep recognizable golden blonde hair, wispy forehead bangs, long side ponytail, warm brown eyes, rounded gentle face and small smile. Reinterpret as a young adult fantasy light mage, fully clothed, not photoreal.
Style: close to Slay the Spire 2's hand-painted character rendering: bold uneven dark outlines, simplified expressive face, angular painted forms, broad matte shadow masses, slightly exaggerated 5.5-head proportions, charming and a little strange dark fairy-tale dungeon aesthetic, readable at small battle size. Avoid glossy generic anime splash-art, 3D, realistic skin, extreme detail.
Composition: one entire character from hair to boots, three-quarter combat-ready view facing toward the RIGHT, face partly visible, feet grounded, ample blank margins around staff, ponytail and clothing. Separate arms from torso silhouette, clear elbows and knees, readable segmented outfit suitable for later 2D cutout animation. Character fills most of portrait frame.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent, no floor, no background, no scenic vignette, no glow cloud.
Constraints: gold-blonde hair must be visible; pink is a deliberate favorite color in costume or ornament. Small light spell at wand tip only. No companion cat, no extra human, no weapon sword, no Ironclad helmet or armor, no logo, no text, no watermark.
Variant P1: the warm, luminous lead design. Rose-pink fitted mage dress with an ivory underlayer and restrained gold trim, modest fitted bodice, broad layered pink skirt panels ending just above the knees, opaque ivory tights, sturdy pink ankle boots, ivory short cape with dusty-pink lining. No hat, so photo-inspired bangs and side ponytail dominate. Pink ribbon tying ponytail, one small golden cat-shaped hair ornament as a subtle transformation motif. Hold a short elegant golden wand with a simple sun-shaped head in the right-facing hand; left palm open preparing a little soft light spell. Soft pink plus ivory plus muted gold, with dark burgundy outlines and cast shadows. Friendly, clever, adventurous rather than idol stage costume. Clear sturdy silhouette.

prompts.fair_skin: Edit this selected P1 character design only: make her visible skin noticeably fairer, a cool light ivory porcelain complexion with a restrained natural pink blush. Preserve the identity and all facial features, blonde wispy bangs and side ponytail, golden cat hair ornament, pink ribbon, white/pink/gold mage dress, cape, wand, pose, full body framing, hand-painted angular shading, uneven dark contour and transparent background exactly. Do not lighten the clothing, hair or the whole image; alter only skin tone on face, neck and hands. No new accessories or text. This is the user-selected '樱粉圣光' design, not a new variant.
prompts.proportions: Refine ONLY the body proportions of this chosen adult fantasy mage design. Keep the newly fair light-ivory skin and restrained blush. Make her legs look a little longer by subtly lengthening the calves (about 7 percent), maintaining plausible knees, ankles, the same ivory stockings and pink boots, and a naturally elegant stance. Increase the bust just slightly (a small natural change, about 5 percent), keeping the same modest covered neckline and the same pink bodice design: no cleavage emphasis, no exaggerated proportions. Preserve face, eyes, blonde bangs, side ponytail, hair ornament, earrings, outfit colors and embroidery, layered skirt, cape, wand, hands, hand-painted matte Slay-the-Spire-like angular style, and clean silhouette. Keep the whole head, hair, staff and both boots within frame with margin. Transparent background. No new object, text or logo. This should read as the same P1 '樱粉圣光', with subtle refinements, not a redesign.
prompts.human_atlas:
Use the reference as the approved character design and create a PRODUCTION 2D CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS ATLAS, not a complete standing character.
Canvas is PORTRAIT 2:3, divided into exactly THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows: twelve equally-sized rectangular cells. No drawn grid lines, no labels, no text. Each cell contains EXACTLY ONE separated illustrated body part centered inside that cell, with at least 10% totally empty transparent padding on all four edges. Parts NEVER touch another cell. Each individual part fills its own cell, so part scales differ; I will scale and assemble them in Godot. Absolutely transparent between parts, no background tint, no glow vignette, no shadows behind parts.
Reproduce this SAME adult blonde P1 pink/ivory/gold light mage, fair ivory skin, long calves, modest slightly fuller bodice, same matte angular painted shadows and dark uneven hand-drawn contour. Complete concealed joint surfaces behind clothing so moving pieces do not expose cut edges.
Exact row-major cell contents:
ROW 1, CELL 1: Head including face, neck, blonde wispy bangs and side hair, golden cat hairclip, earrings; same three-quarter RIGHT facing gentle smile, brown eyes OPEN. NO long ponytail, NO torso. Hairclip and pink tie at back of head are present.
ROW 1, CELL 2: EXACT SAME head, scale, pose, face and hair as row1cell1, eyes peacefully CLOSED for blinking. NO ponytail, NO torso.
ROW 1, CELL 3: The pink corset bodice with covered bust and waist, ivory short shoulder capelet and gold sun embroidery/clasp, from shoulders through hips. NO head, NO arms, NO skirt, NO long back cape. Extend small shoulder and neck join surfaces.
ROW 2, CELL 1: The full pink and ivory layered skirt from waist to knee-level hem; gold trim and embroidered front panels. NO legs, no torso.
ROW 2, CELL 2: ONLY long flowing ivory cape, pink lining, gold sun embroidery, from nape attachment down to below knee, viewed from same angle. No person, no short shoulder capelet. Natural fan-shaped drape to left.
ROW 2, CELL 3: ONLY blonde long side ponytail with pink ribbon, attachment at top, thick wavy golden strands hanging down, turning slightly left. No head.
ROW 3, CELL 1: The STAFF-HOLDING arm from shoulder to fingertips, complete ivory puffed long sleeve with pink-gold cuff and fair hand curled in a staff grip. SAME diagonal-bent arm gesture as reference. NO actual staff. No torso.
ROW 3, CELL 2: The FREE SPELLCASTING arm from shoulder to fingertips: ivory puffed sleeve, pink-gold cuff, fair open palm facing up to right, slightly bent elbow. No magic effect, no torso.
ROW 3, CELL 3: ONLY the complete slim golden sun-headed wand from reference, straight and upright, no hand, no magic glow surrounding it.
ROW 4, CELL 1: ONLY the rear/left leg, ivory opaque stocking from upper thigh through the subtly elongated calf, ending in the exact pink lace-up ankle boot, leg slants slightly left, toes pointing right. No skirt or other leg.
ROW 4, CELL 2: ONLY the front/right leg, ivory opaque stocking from upper thigh through the subtly elongated calf, same pink boot, leg near straight toes pointing right. No skirt or other leg.
ROW 4, CELL 3: ONLY a small pink and pale-gold curling light spell, transparent surrounding empty space. No hand and no wand.
All parts must be readable clean complete cutouts, matching one coherent character. The two heads must be near-identical apart from eyelids. Do not create any assembled whole character anywhere. Do not duplicate any part except the blinking head variant.

Keep ALL twelve part silhouettes, positions, scale, colors, opaque internal paint and dark outlines precisely unchanged. No rearrangement, no labels. Everything outside the actual twelve solid part silhouettes should be transparent, not painted black or white.
